== Introduction ==

Armed Assault files with raP encoding are currently ''identical'' to [[raP File Format - Elite|Elite]] raP files with the sole exception that ArmA raP files do not currently have any authentication signatures.

This lack of signature may well change as OEM model makers and campaign suppliers look to protecting their efforts.
